views.label: Attendance to Payout
views.note: Follow biometric terminal logs through attendance aggregation into finalized monthly net payout.

views.label: Absence & Off-Day Engine
views.note: Preserve explicit absences and calculate accurate weekly offs before salary proration.

cards.title: Authoritative Attendance
items: Explicit absent days recorded in attendance logs are never reduced or masked by calendar math
Biometric terminal punches are debounced to prevent duplicate punches

cards.title: Transparent Proration
items: Monthly salary employees earn day-wise: payableDays = daysPresent + daysOff + daysLeave
Integer daily rate: perDayRate = Math.round(base_salary / daysInMonth)
Absence deduction strictly evaluates to perDayRate * daysAbsent (e.g. 968 * 2 = 1936)

cards.title: Daily Wage Clearance
items: Daily Come, Daily Pay: workers cleared daily on shift completion
Daily voucher prints today's daily wage rate rather than accumulated monthly total
Monthly payroll acts as audit ledger with zero outstanding balance

cards.title: A5 & Inter Standards
items: Universal Inter Google Font applied across web UI, print previews, and PDFs
Official A5 Half-A4 dimensions (148mm × 210mm) at 300 DPI print / 72 DPI screen

cards.title: Audit & Security
items: Soft-delete preserves history for active audit trails
Reactivating resigned workers requires super-admin password gate
